name: Jiangling Motors Corporation, Ltd.
summary: Jiangling Motors Corporation, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of automobiles and automobile parts in China and internationally. It offers light trucks, pickups, light buses, multi-purpose vehicles, other commercial and passenger vehicles, and sport utility vehicles; and engines, frames, axles, and other components. The company is also involved in retail, wholesale, and lease of automobiles; and technical and business information consultation. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
